question: On /work/data/data.csv, do degree-2 polynomial features raise the test accuracy of a logistic regression by at least 2 percentage points over the same model on the raw features?
background: The data is in /work/data/data.csv: 800 rows, 10 numeric features f0-f9, and a binary label y. Keep 25% as a fixed, stratified test split with random_state=0, and do not tune anything on the test set. Raw model: StandardScaler, then LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000). Polynomial model: StandardScaler, PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, include_bias=False), StandardScaler, then LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000). A blog post reported a gain of 5 points from polynomial features on similar tabular data.
